entries.title: Opinion Particles in a Consensus Box
entries.description: A cloud of colored spheres (agents) float in a clear box, gently bumping and briefly attaching to swap colors toward local majority opinions, with trails showing their recent color changes and a side bar graph updating the global vote distribution.

entries.title: Rotating Council Table with Voting Lights
entries.description: A circular table of fixed cylinders (delegates) around a central transparent sphere flashes colored beams toward the center to cast votes, with beams colliding and merging into a growing central “consensus” light whose color and brightness change as more aligned votes arrive.

entries.title: Network of Voting Nodes on a Floating Lattice
entries.description: A 3D lattice of small spheres (nodes) connected by thin translucent edges passes vote tokens as glowing particles that travel, split, and merge along edges, while each node changes color based on its current local majority and displays its count as a hovering label.

entries.title: Flocking Voters Aligning Opinions
entries.description: A swarm of flying spheres with arrow-shaped tails wander in 3D, steering to stay near neighbors and slowly rotating their tail arrows and colors toward the average orientation/opinion of their neighbors, leaving short fading trails to show shifts toward consensus.

entries.title: Two-Party Voting Clusters with Boundary Dynamics
entries.description: Red and blue spheres randomly move and elastically collide in a box divided by a transparent plane; when spheres collide near the plane, one may flip color probabilistically, letting the dividing plane slide and rotate as a dynamic “consensus boundary” with its position labeled.

entries.title: Spinning Planet of Voters with Regional Consensus
entries.description: Small colored spheres sit on the surface of a slowly rotating transparent globe, diffusing along the surface and exchanging colors with nearest neighbors, while semi-transparent patches form and dissolve showing regional consensus zones that grow, split, and merge.

entries.title: Opinion Diffusion in a 3D Grid City
entries.description: A stationary 3D grid of buildings (boxes) each contains one visible colored sphere (opinion) that occasionally “broadcasts” semi-transparent pulses to neighbors, nudging them toward its color, while an overhead heatmap plane floats above the city showing consensus intensity.

entries.title: Jury Deliberation Chamber
entries.description: Twelve labeled spheres sit around a stationary circular table and periodically float up to connect with glowing rods when they speak; when a sphere is influenced, it smoothly morphs its color toward the speaking sphere’s color, and a central meter tracks how close they are to unanimity.

entries.title: Opinion Islands Connected by Voting Ferries
entries.description: Separate platforms (islands) hover in space with clusters of differently colored spheres on each; small ferry platforms shuttle spheres between islands, where arrivals can cause local color shifts, while thin translucent bridges fade in when two islands reach similar consensus.

entries.title: Voter Attraction to Competing Leaders

entries.title: Consensus via Magnetic Alignment
